name: cdk
//overrides-rationale: brace-expansion is forced to >=5.0.6 to clear GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2 (DoS via large numeric ranges) for the transitively-resolved copies (vitest -> minimatch -> brace-expansion). aws-cdk-lib BUNDLES its own brace-expansion 5.0.5 inside the published tarball; npm overrides can't reach bundled deps, so that copy stays vulnerable until aws-cdk-lib publishes a fix. The DoS isn't reachable from our usage because CDK feeds the bundled brace-expansion only file paths we control during synth, never untrusted input. The Dependabot alert for the aws-cdk-lib bundled copy has been dismissed as tolerable_risk.
